caption: The drawing depicts a single chair with an ornate wooden frame. The chair features a rounded backrest with intricate carvings at the top and decorative, curved arm supports attached to the seat. Both the seat and the backrest are padded and covered in a greenish-blue material that appears to have a slight sheen. The padded sections are bordered with small metal studs. The chair sits on a swivel base with four sturdy, outward-angled wooden legs, each ending in small brass castors. The wood of the frame and legs is colored in shades of brown, and the composition is centered on the page, with the background left blank. Below the chair, text reads “APPROXIMATELY 1/4 ACTUAL SIZE.”
title: Office Swivel Chair
